# Levenshtein edit distance by dynamic programming over two rows.
fn min3(a: u32, b: u32, c: u32) -> u32
    var m = a
    if b < m
        m = b
    if c < m
        m = c
    return m

fn distance(a: &text, b: &text) -> u32
    let n = b.len()
    var prev: List[u32] = [j as u32 for j in 0..=n]
    for i in 1..=a.len()
        var cur: List[u32] = [i as u32]
        for j in 1..=n
            let cost: u32 = if a[i - 1] == b[j - 1] then 0 else 1
            cur.append(min3(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + cost))
        prev = cur
    return prev[n]

const EMPTY: text = ""

module energy
#!lib crypto
use enc
use hash.blake3

# JCP v0.3 energy receipts (survey M16, part 1): the JCR-1 receipt of
# JCP section 8 under the `jcp/2` profile, its content id, the COSE_Sign1
# envelope (RFC 9052, EdDSA, alg -8) signed with Ed25519 (crypto), did:key
# identities for Ed25519 keys, and replay of a verified receipt stream
# into budget state (8.1) and per-worker accounting (8.2).
# Canonical bytes are deterministic CBOR from `enc` (RFC 8949 4.2.1) and
# ids are blake3(canonical_cbor(value)) in lowercase hex (JCP section 3).
# The library never reads a meter: cost_uj and its provenance come from
# the caller (a logged host.Energy result).
# Signing and verifying cost one Ed25519 operation each (about 30M fuel),
# so run them one per input on the host.

error BadReceipt(why: text)
error BadDid(at: i64)

pub const PROV_HW: text = "HwShunt"
pub const PROV_MODEL: text = "ModelBased"
pub const PROV_EST: text = "Estimator"

# One decision. deny_reason is "" on allow; partial = false means
# energy_coverage Whole (omitted from the core); chain_ids is [] for a
# one-link chain; payload_hash is "" only in a decoded jcp/1 receipt.
pub struct Receipt
    profile: text
    grant_id: text
    issuer: text
    subject: text
    resource: text
    action: text
    payload_hash: text
    frame_kind: text
    trust: text
    verdict: text
    deny_reason: text
    cost_uj: i64
    provenance: text
    partial: bool
    budget_remaining_uj: i64
    budget_uj: i64
    steward: text
    chain_ids: List[text]

fn en_cat(a: List[i64], b: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    var o = a
    for x in b
        o.push(x)
    return o

pub fn hex_of(b: &[i64]) -> text
    let ds = "0123456789abcdef".chars()
    var s = ""
    for x in b
        s = s + copy(ds[(x >> 4) as usize]) + copy(ds[(x & 15) as usize])
    return s

fn hnib(c: i64) -> i64
    if c >= 48 and c <= 57
        return c - 48
    if c >= 97 and c <= 102
        return c - 87
    return -1

fn is_hex(t: &text) -> bool
    if t.len_bytes() % 2 == 1
        return false
    var ok = true
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < t.len_bytes() bound 16777216
        ok = ok and hnib(t[i] as i64) >= 0
        i += 1
    return ok

fn utf8_of(t: &text) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < t.len_bytes() bound 16777216
        o.push(t[i] as i64)
        i += 1
    return o

# ---------------- base58btc and did:key ----------------

const B58: text = "123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz"

pub fn base58_encode(b: &[i64]) -> text
    var zeros: usize = 0
    while zeros < b.len() and b[zeros] == 0 bound 16777216
        zeros += 1
    # base-58 digits, least significant first
    var ds: List[i64] = []
    for x in b
        var cy = x
        for k in 0..ds.len()
            let v = ds[k] * 256 + cy
            ds[k] = v % 58
            cy = v / 58
        while cy > 0 bound 64
            ds.push(cy % 58)
            cy = cy / 58
    let al = B58.chars()
    var s = ""
    for _ in 0..zeros
        s = s + "1"
    var k = ds.len()
    while k > 0 bound 16777216
        k -= 1
        s = s + copy(al[ds[k] as usize])
    return s

fn b58_val(c: i64) -> i64
    let al = utf8_of(&B58)
    for k in 0..al.len()
        if al[k] == c
            return k as i64
    return -1

pub fn base58_decode(s: &text) -> List[i64] ! BadDid
    var zeros: usize = 0
    while zeros < s.len_bytes() and (s[zeros] as i64) == 49 bound 16777216
        zeros += 1
    var bs: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.len_bytes() bound 16777216
        let d = b58_val(s[i] as i64)
        if d < 0
            fail BadDid(at: i as i64)
        var cy = d
        for k in 0..bs.len()
            let v = bs[k] * 58 + cy
            bs[k] = v & 255
            cy = v >> 8
        while cy > 0 bound 64
            bs.push(cy & 255)
            cy = cy >> 8
        i += 1
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for _ in 0..zeros
        o.push(0)
    var k = bs.len()
    while k > 0 bound 16777216
        k -= 1
        o.push(bs[k])
    return o

# did:key of a 32-byte Ed25519 public key: "did:key:z" + base58btc of the
# multicodec ed25519-pub prefix 0xed 0x01 and the key (W3C did:key).
pub fn did_key(pk: &[i64]) -> text
    let b = en_cat([237, 1], pk)
    return "did:key:z" + base58_encode(&b)

pub fn did_key_pk(did: &text) -> List[i64] ! BadDid
    let p = "did:key:z"
    let pb = utf8_of(&p)
    let db = utf8_of(did)
    if db.len() <= pb.len()
        fail BadDid(at: 0)
    for k in 0..pb.len()
        if db[k] != pb[k]
            fail BadDid(at: k as i64)
    var rest = ""
    let cs = did.chars()
    for k in pb.len()..cs.len()
        rest = rest + copy(cs[k])
    let b = try base58_decode(&rest)
    if b.len() != 34 or b[0] != 237 or b[1] != 1
        fail BadDid(at: pb.len() as i64)
    var pk: List[i64] = []
    for k in 2..34
        pk.push(b[k])
    return pk

# ---------------- the jcp/2 core ----------------

fn jt(t: text) -> enc.Cbor = enc.CText(t: t)

fn jn(v: i64) -> enc.Cbor = enc.CInt(v: v)

fn check_fields(r: &Receipt, need_payload: bool) -> text
    if not is_hex(&r.grant_id) or r.grant_id.len_bytes() == 0
        return "grant_id"
    if not is_hex(&r.resource)
        return "resource"
    if need_payload and (not is_hex(&r.payload_hash) or r.payload_hash.len_bytes() == 0)
        return "payload_hash"
    if r.trust != "control" and r.trust != "data"
        return "trust"
    if r.verdict != "allow" and r.verdict != "deny"
        return "verdict"
    if r.verdict == "allow" and r.deny_reason != ""
        return "deny_reason"
    if r.verdict == "deny" and r.deny_reason == ""
        return "deny_reason"
    if r.provenance != PROV_HW and r.provenance != PROV_MODEL and r.provenance != PROV_EST
        return "energy_provenance"
    if r.cost_uj < 0 or r.budget_uj < 0 or r.budget_remaining_uj < 0
        return "uint"
    if r.budget_remaining_uj > r.budget_uj
        return "budget_remaining_uj"
    for g in r.chain_ids
        if not is_hex(&g) or g.len_bytes() == 0
            return "chain_ids"
    return ""

fn core_value(r: &Receipt) -> enc.Cbor
    var ks: List[enc.Cbor] = [jt("jcp_receipt"), jt("grant_id"), jt("issuer"), jt("subject"), jt("resource"), jt("action")]
    var vs: List[enc.Cbor] = [jt(copy(r.profile)), jt(copy(r.grant_id)), jt(copy(r.issuer)), jt(copy(r.subject)), jt(copy(r.resource)), jt(copy(r.action))]
    ks.push(jt("payload_hash"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.payload_hash)))
    ks.push(jt("frame_kind"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.frame_kind)))
    ks.push(jt("trust"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.trust)))
    ks.push(jt("verdict"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.verdict)))
    if r.verdict == "deny"
        ks.push(jt("deny_reason"))
        vs.push(jt(copy(r.deny_reason)))
    ks.push(jt("cost_uj"))
    vs.push(jn(r.cost_uj))
    ks.push(jt("energy_provenance"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.provenance)))
    if r.partial
        ks.push(jt("energy_coverage"))
        vs.push(jt("Partial"))
    ks.push(jt("budget_remaining_uj"))
    vs.push(jn(r.budget_remaining_uj))
    ks.push(jt("budget_uj"))
    vs.push(jn(r.budget_uj))
    ks.push(jt("steward"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.steward)))
    if r.chain_ids.len() > 0
        var items: List[enc.Cbor] = []
        for g in r.chain_ids
            items.push(jt(copy(g)))
        ks.push(jt("chain_ids"))
        vs.push(enc.CArr(items: items))
    return enc.CMap(keys: ks, vals: vs)

# The canonical bytes of a receipt core. Only jcp/2 is minted (JCP 8:
# implementations MUST NOT mint jcp/1).
pub fn receipt_core(r: &Receipt) -> List[i64] ! BadReceipt
    if r.profile != "jcp/2"
        fail BadReceipt(why: "profile")
    let bad = check_fields(r, true)
    if bad != ""
        fail BadReceipt(why: bad)
    let v = core_value(r)
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

# Content id: blake3 of the canonical core, lowercase hex.
pub fn receipt_id(r: &Receipt) -> text ! BadReceipt
    let c = try receipt_core(r)
    let h = blake3.blake3(&c)
    return hex_of(&h)

pub fn content_id(c: &enc.Cbor) -> text
    let b = enc.cbor_encode(c)
    let h = blake3.blake3(&b)
    return hex_of(&h)

# ---------------- COSE_Sign1 ----------------

# Protected header {1: -8 (alg EdDSA), 4: kid}, as its bstr contents; kid
# is the steward id as UTF-8 bytes (as in JCP conformance/v1). The
# unprotected header is the empty map.
pub fn protected_header(kid: &text) -> List[i64]
    let v = enc.CMap(keys: [jn(1), jn(4)], vals: [jn(-8), enc.CBytes(b: utf8_of(kid))])
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

# Sig_structure = ["Signature1", protected, external_aad = h'', payload]
pub fn sig_structure(prot: &[i64], payload: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let v = enc.CArr(items: [jt("Signature1"), enc.CBytes(b: copy(prot)), enc.CBytes(b: []), enc.CBytes(b: copy(payload))])
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

# Tag 18 [protected, {}, payload, signature]
pub fn envelope(payload: &[i64], kid: &text, sig: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let unprot = enc.CMap(keys: [], vals: [])
    let v = enc.CTag(tag: 18, item: Box(enc.CArr(items: [enc.CBytes(b: protected_header(kid)), unprot, enc.CBytes(b: copy(payload)), enc.CBytes(b: copy(sig))])))
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

pub struct OpenedReceipt
    receipt: Receipt
    prot: List[i64]
    payload: List[i64]
    kid: text
    sig: List[i64]

fn bytes_field(c: &enc.Cbor) -> List[i64] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CBytes(b: b) -> return copy(b)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: "envelope")

fn text_of(c: &enc.Cbor) -> text ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CText(t: t) -> return copy(t)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: "type")

fn uint_of(c: &enc.Cbor) -> i64 ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CInt(v: v) -> return if v >= 0 then v else 0 - 1
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: "type")

fn map_keys(c: &enc.Cbor, why: text) -> List[enc.Cbor] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CMap(keys: ks, vals: _vs) -> return copy(ks)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: why)

fn map_vals(c: &enc.Cbor, why: text) -> List[enc.Cbor] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CMap(keys: _ks, vals: vs) -> return copy(vs)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: why)

fn arr_of(c: &enc.Cbor, why: text) -> List[enc.Cbor] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CArr(items: items) -> return copy(items)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: why)

fn tag_num(c: &enc.Cbor) -> i64
    match c
        CTag(tag: tag, item: _item) -> return tag
        _ -> return -1

fn cbor_copy(c: &enc.Cbor) -> enc.Cbor = copy(c)

fn tag_item(c: &enc.Cbor) -> enc.Cbor
    match c
        CTag(tag: _tag, item: item) -> return cbor_copy(item)
        _ -> return enc.CInt(v: -1)

fn kid_text(b: &[i64]) -> text
    let al = " !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~".chars()
    var s = ""
    for x in b
        if x >= 32 and x < 127
            s = s + copy(al[(x - 32) as usize])
        else
            s = s + "?"
    return s

const FIELDS: text = "jcp_receipt grant_id issuer subject resource action payload_hash frame_kind trust verdict deny_reason cost_uj energy_provenance energy_coverage budget_remaining_uj budget_uj steward chain_ids"

# Decode a core strictly: canonical bytes (enc refuses non-canonical
# input), only known fields, the right types, and the profile named in
# the core itself: jcp/2 needs payload_hash, jcp/1 must not cy it.
pub fn decode_core(payload: &[i64]) -> Receipt ! BadReceipt
    let c = enc.cbor_decode(payload) catch enc.CInt(v: -1)
    var r = Receipt(profile: "", grant_id: "", issuer: "", subject: "", resource: "", action: "", payload_hash: "", frame_kind: "", trust: "", verdict: "", deny_reason: "", cost_uj: -1, provenance: "", partial: false, budget_remaining_uj: -1, budget_uj: -1, steward: "", chain_ids: [])
    var seen = ""
    let ks = try map_keys(&c, "core")
    let vs = try map_vals(&c, "core")
    let fields = FIELDS.split(" ")
    for k in 0..ks.len()
        let name = try text_of(&ks[k])

            fail BadReceipt(why: "unknown field")

        let v = copy(vs[k])

            r.cost_uj = try uint_of(&v)
            continue
        if name == "budget_uj"
            r.budget_uj = try uint_of(&v)
            continue
        if name == "budget_remaining_uj"
            r.budget_remaining_uj = try uint_of(&v)
            continue

            let items = try arr_of(&v, "type")
            for it in items

            if r.chain_ids.len() == 0
                fail BadReceipt(why: "chain_ids")
            continue

        if name == "jcp_receipt"
            r.profile = copy(t)
        if name == "grant_id"
            r.grant_id = copy(t)
        if name == "issuer"
            r.issuer = copy(t)
        if name == "subject"
            r.subject = copy(t)
        if name == "resource"
            r.resource = copy(t)
        if name == "action"
            r.action = copy(t)
        if name == "payload_hash"
            r.payload_hash = copy(t)
        if name == "frame_kind"
            r.frame_kind = copy(t)
        if name == "trust"
            r.trust = copy(t)
        if name == "verdict"
            r.verdict = copy(t)
        if name == "deny_reason"
            r.deny_reason = copy(t)
        if name == "energy_provenance"
            r.provenance = copy(t)
        if name == "steward"

        fail BadReceipt(why: "alg")
    let kid = try bytes_field(&vs[1])
    let uk = try map_keys(&it[1], "unprotected")
    if uk.len() != 0
        fail BadReceipt(why: "unprotected")
    let payload = try bytes_field(&it[2])
    let sig = try bytes_field(&it[3])
    if sig.len() != 64
        fail BadReceipt(why: "signature")
    let r = try decode_core(&payload)
    let kt = kid_text(&kid)
    if utf8_of(&kt) != kid or kt != r.steward
        fail BadReceipt(why: "steward")
    return OpenedReceipt(receipt: r, prot: ph, payload: payload, kid: kt, sig: sig)

# seal_receipt: sign the Sig_structure with the steward's 32-byte seed (hex).
# The steward must be the did:key of that seed's public key.
pub fn seal_receipt(r: &Receipt, seed_hex: text) -> List[i64] ! BadReceipt
    let core = try receipt_core(r)
    let pk = ed_pubkey(copy(seed_hex))
    let pkb = did_key_pk(&r.steward) catch []
    if hex_of(&pkb) != pk
        fail BadReceipt(why: "steward")
    let prot = protected_header(&r.steward)
    let sig = ed_sign(seed_hex, sig_structure(&prot, &core))
    let sb = hex_bytes(&sig)
    return envelope(&core, &r.steward, &sb)

fn hex_bytes(h: &text) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i + 1 < h.len_bytes() bound 16777216
        o.push(hnib(h[i] as i64) * 16 + hnib(h[i + 1] as i64))
        i += 2
    return o

fn opened_none() -> OpenedReceipt = OpenedReceipt(receipt: Receipt(profile: "", grant_id: "", issuer: "", subject: "", resource: "", action: "", payload_hash: "", frame_kind: "", trust: "", verdict: "", deny_reason: "", cost_uj: -1, provenance: "", partial: false, budget_remaining_uj: -1, budget_uj: -1, steward: "", chain_ids: []), prot: [], payload: [], kid: "", sig: [])

# Verify an envelope under a given Ed25519 public key (32 bytes): it
# opens, its core is valid under its own profile, and the signature over
# the Sig_structure verifies (a wrong steward key fails, JCP C5).
pub fn verify_with(env: &[i64], pk: &[i64]) -> bool
    let o = open_envelope(env) catch opened_none()
    if o.payload.len() == 0 or pk.len() != 32
        return false
    return ed_verify(hex_of(pk), sig_structure(&o.prot, &o.payload), hex_of(&o.sig))

# Verify an envelope whose steward is a did:key (the key is the id).
pub fn verify(env: &[i64]) -> bool
    let o = open_envelope(env) catch opened_none()
    let pk = did_key_pk(&o.receipt.steward) catch []
    return pk.len() == 32 and verify_with(env, &pk)

# ---------------- replay and accounting ----------------

pub struct Spend
    grant_id: text
    spent_uj: i64

# Replay a verified receipt stream (JCP 8.1): every allow debits its cost
# to each grant it names (chain_ids, root first, or grant_id alone); a
# deny debits nothing (C3). Grants appear in first-seen order.
pub fn replay(rs: &[Receipt]) -> List[Spend]
    var out: List[Spend] = []
    for r in rs
        if r.verdict != "allow"
            continue
        var names: List[text] = copy(r.chain_ids)
        if names.len() == 0
            names.push(copy(r.grant_id))
        for g in names
            var hit = false
            for k in 0..out.len()
                if out[k].grant_id == g
                    out[k].spent_uj += r.cost_uj
                    hit = true
            if not hit
                out.push(Spend(grant_id: copy(g), spent_uj: r.cost_uj))
    return out

pub fn spent(ls: &[Spend], g: &text) -> i64
    for s in ls
        if s.grant_id == copy(g)
            return s.spent_uj
    return 0

# Conservation over a stream: replaying receipts in order, each receipt's
# budget_remaining_uj equals budget_uj minus what its grant has spent so
# far (after its own debit when it allows).
pub fn conserves(rs: &[Receipt]) -> bool
    var seen: List[Receipt] = []
    for r in rs
        seen.push(copy(r))
        let led = replay(&seen)
        let s = spent(&led, &r.grant_id)
        if r.budget_remaining_uj != r.budget_uj - s
            return false
    return true

pub struct Tally
    grant_id: text
    subject: text
    allowed: i64
    denied: i64
    joules_uj: i64

# Group accounting (JCP 8.2), keyed by (grant_id, subject).
pub fn tally(rs: &[Receipt]) -> List[Tally]
    var out: List[Tally] = []
    for r in rs
        var at: i64 = -1
        for k in 0..out.len()
            if out[k].grant_id == r.grant_id and out[k].subject == r.subject
                at = k as i64
        if at < 0
            out.push(Tally(grant_id: copy(r.grant_id), subject: copy(r.subject), allowed: 0, denied: 0, joules_uj: 0))
            at = (out.len() - 1) as i64
        let i = at as usize
        if r.verdict == "allow"
            out[i].allowed += 1
            out[i].joules_uj += r.cost_uj
        else
            out[i].denied += 1
    return out

module energy
use enc
use hash.blake3
use crypto

# JCP v0.3 energy receipts (survey M16, part 1): the JCR-1 receipt of
# JCP section 8 under the `jcp/2` profile, its content id, the COSE_Sign1
# envelope (RFC 9052, EdDSA, alg -8) signed with Ed25519 (crypto), did:key
# identities for Ed25519 keys, and replay of a verified receipt stream
# into budget state (8.1) and per-worker accounting (8.2).
# Canonical bytes are deterministic CBOR from `enc` (RFC 8949 4.2.1) and
# ids are blake3(canonical_cbor(value)) in lowercase hex (JCP section 3).
# The library never reads a meter: cost_uj and its provenance come from
# the caller (a logged host.Energy result).
# Signing and verifying cost one Ed25519 operation each (about 30M fuel),
# so run them one per input on the host.

error BadReceipt(why: text)
error BadDid(at: i64)

pub const PROV_HW: text = "HwShunt"
pub const PROV_MODEL: text = "ModelBased"
pub const PROV_EST: text = "Estimator"

# One decision. deny_reason is "" on allow; partial = false means
# energy_coverage Whole (omitted from the core); chain_ids is [] for a
# one-link chain; payload_hash is "" only in a decoded jcp/1 receipt.
pub struct Receipt
    profile: text
    grant_id: text
    issuer: text
    subject: text
    resource: text
    action: text
    payload_hash: text
    frame_kind: text
    trust: text
    verdict: text
    deny_reason: text
    cost_uj: i64
    provenance: text
    partial: bool
    budget_remaining_uj: i64
    budget_uj: i64
    steward: text
    chain_ids: List[text]

fn en_cat(a: List[i64], b: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    var o = a
    for x in b
        o.push(x)
    return o

pub fn hex_of(b: &[i64]) -> text
    let ds = "0123456789abcdef".chars()
    var s = ""
    for x in b
        s = s + copy(ds[(x >> 4) as usize]) + copy(ds[(x & 15) as usize])
    return s

fn hnib(c: i64) -> i64
    if c >= 48 and c <= 57
        return c - 48
    if c >= 97 and c <= 102
        return c - 87
    return -1

fn is_hex(t: &text) -> bool
    if t.len_bytes() % 2 == 1
        return false
    var ok = true
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < t.len_bytes() bound 16777216
        ok = ok and hnib(t[i] as i64) >= 0
        i += 1
    return ok

fn utf8_of(t: &text) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < t.len_bytes() bound 16777216
        o.push(t[i] as i64)
        i += 1
    return o

# ---------------- base58btc and did:key ----------------

const B58: text = "123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz"

pub fn base58_encode(b: &[i64]) -> text
    var zeros: usize = 0
    while zeros < b.len() and b[zeros] == 0 bound 16777216
        zeros += 1
    # base-58 digits, least significant first
    var ds: List[i64] = []
    for x in b
        var cy = x
        for k in 0..ds.len()
            let v = ds[k] * 256 + cy
            ds[k] = v % 58
            cy = v / 58
        while cy > 0 bound 64
            ds.push(cy % 58)
            cy = cy / 58
    let al = B58.chars()
    var s = ""
    for _ in 0..zeros
        s = s + "1"
    var k = ds.len()
    while k > 0 bound 16777216
        k -= 1
        s = s + copy(al[ds[k] as usize])
    return s

fn b58_val(c: i64) -> i64
    let al = utf8_of(&B58)
    for k in 0..al.len()
        if al[k] == c
            return k as i64
    return -1

pub fn base58_decode(s: &text) -> List[i64] ! BadDid
    var zeros: usize = 0
    while zeros < s.len_bytes() and (s[zeros] as i64) == 49 bound 16777216
        zeros += 1
    var bs: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < s.len_bytes() bound 16777216
        let d = b58_val(s[i] as i64)
        if d < 0
            fail BadDid(at: i as i64)
        var cy = d
        for k in 0..bs.len()
            let v = bs[k] * 58 + cy
            bs[k] = v & 255
            cy = v >> 8
        while cy > 0 bound 64
            bs.push(cy & 255)
            cy = cy >> 8
        i += 1
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for _ in 0..zeros
        o.push(0)
    var k = bs.len()
    while k > 0 bound 16777216
        k -= 1
        o.push(bs[k])
    return o

# did:key of a 32-byte Ed25519 public key: "did:key:z" + base58btc of the
# multicodec ed25519-pub prefix 0xed 0x01 and the key (W3C did:key).
pub fn did_key(pk: &[i64]) -> text
    let b = en_cat([237, 1], pk)
    return "did:key:z" + base58_encode(&b)

pub fn did_key_pk(did: &text) -> List[i64] ! BadDid
    let p = "did:key:z"
    let pb = utf8_of(&p)
    let db = utf8_of(did)
    if db.len() <= pb.len()
        fail BadDid(at: 0)
    for k in 0..pb.len()
        if db[k] != pb[k]
            fail BadDid(at: k as i64)
    var rest = ""
    let cs = did.chars()
    for k in pb.len()..cs.len()
        rest = rest + copy(cs[k])
    let b = try base58_decode(&rest)
    if b.len() != 34 or b[0] != 237 or b[1] != 1
        fail BadDid(at: pb.len() as i64)
    var pk: List[i64] = []
    for k in 2..34
        pk.push(b[k])
    return pk

# ---------------- the jcp/2 core ----------------

fn jt(t: text) -> enc.Cbor = enc.CText(t: t)

fn jn(v: i64) -> enc.Cbor = enc.CInt(v: v)

fn check_fields(r: &Receipt, need_payload: bool) -> text
    if not is_hex(&r.grant_id) or r.grant_id.len_bytes() == 0
        return "grant_id"
    if not is_hex(&r.resource)
        return "resource"
    if need_payload and (not is_hex(&r.payload_hash) or r.payload_hash.len_bytes() == 0)
        return "payload_hash"
    if r.trust != "control" and r.trust != "data"
        return "trust"
    if r.verdict != "allow" and r.verdict != "deny"
        return "verdict"
    if r.verdict == "allow" and r.deny_reason != ""
        return "deny_reason"
    if r.verdict == "deny" and r.deny_reason == ""
        return "deny_reason"
    if r.provenance != PROV_HW and r.provenance != PROV_MODEL and r.provenance != PROV_EST
        return "energy_provenance"
    if r.cost_uj < 0 or r.budget_uj < 0 or r.budget_remaining_uj < 0
        return "uint"
    if r.budget_remaining_uj > r.budget_uj
        return "budget_remaining_uj"
    for g in r.chain_ids
        if not is_hex(&g) or g.len_bytes() == 0
            return "chain_ids"
    return ""

fn core_value(r: &Receipt) -> enc.Cbor
    var ks: List[enc.Cbor] = [jt("jcp_receipt"), jt("grant_id"), jt("issuer"), jt("subject"), jt("resource"), jt("action")]
    var vs: List[enc.Cbor] = [jt(copy(r.profile)), jt(copy(r.grant_id)), jt(copy(r.issuer)), jt(copy(r.subject)), jt(copy(r.resource)), jt(copy(r.action))]
    ks.push(jt("payload_hash"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.payload_hash)))
    ks.push(jt("frame_kind"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.frame_kind)))
    ks.push(jt("trust"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.trust)))
    ks.push(jt("verdict"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.verdict)))
    if r.verdict == "deny"
        ks.push(jt("deny_reason"))
        vs.push(jt(copy(r.deny_reason)))
    ks.push(jt("cost_uj"))
    vs.push(jn(r.cost_uj))
    ks.push(jt("energy_provenance"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.provenance)))
    if r.partial
        ks.push(jt("energy_coverage"))
        vs.push(jt("Partial"))
    ks.push(jt("budget_remaining_uj"))
    vs.push(jn(r.budget_remaining_uj))
    ks.push(jt("budget_uj"))
    vs.push(jn(r.budget_uj))
    ks.push(jt("steward"))
    vs.push(jt(copy(r.steward)))
    if r.chain_ids.len() > 0
        var items: List[enc.Cbor] = []
        for g in r.chain_ids
            items.push(jt(copy(g)))
        ks.push(jt("chain_ids"))
        vs.push(enc.CArr(items: items))
    return enc.CMap(keys: ks, vals: vs)

# The canonical bytes of a receipt core. Only jcp/2 is minted (JCP 8:
# implementations MUST NOT mint jcp/1).
pub fn receipt_core(r: &Receipt) -> List[i64] ! BadReceipt
    if r.profile != "jcp/2"
        fail BadReceipt(why: "profile")
    let bad = check_fields(r, true)
    if bad != ""
        fail BadReceipt(why: bad)
    let v = core_value(r)
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

# Content id: blake3 of the canonical core, lowercase hex.
pub fn receipt_id(r: &Receipt) -> text ! BadReceipt
    let c = try receipt_core(r)
    let h = blake3.blake3(&c)
    return hex_of(&h)

pub fn content_id(c: &enc.Cbor) -> text
    let b = enc.cbor_encode(c)
    let h = blake3.blake3(&b)
    return hex_of(&h)

# ---------------- COSE_Sign1 ----------------

# Protected header {1: -8 (alg EdDSA), 4: kid}, as its bstr contents; kid
# is the steward id as UTF-8 bytes (as in JCP conformance/v1). The
# unprotected header is the empty map.
pub fn protected_header(kid: &text) -> List[i64]
    let v = enc.CMap(keys: [jn(1), jn(4)], vals: [jn(-8), enc.CBytes(b: utf8_of(kid))])
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

# Sig_structure = ["Signature1", protected, external_aad = h'', payload]
pub fn sig_structure(prot: &[i64], payload: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let v = enc.CArr(items: [jt("Signature1"), enc.CBytes(b: copy(prot)), enc.CBytes(b: []), enc.CBytes(b: copy(payload))])
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

# Tag 18 [protected, {}, payload, signature]
pub fn envelope(payload: &[i64], kid: &text, sig: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let unprot = enc.CMap(keys: [], vals: [])
    let v = enc.CTag(tag: 18, item: Box(enc.CArr(items: [enc.CBytes(b: protected_header(kid)), unprot, enc.CBytes(b: copy(payload)), enc.CBytes(b: copy(sig))])))
    return enc.cbor_encode(&v)

pub struct OpenedReceipt
    receipt: Receipt
    prot: List[i64]
    payload: List[i64]
    kid: text
    sig: List[i64]

fn bytes_field(c: &enc.Cbor) -> List[i64] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CBytes(b: b) -> return copy(b)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: "envelope")

fn text_of(c: &enc.Cbor) -> text ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CText(t: t) -> return copy(t)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: "type")

fn uint_of(c: &enc.Cbor) -> i64 ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CInt(v: v) -> return if v >= 0 then v else 0 - 1
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: "type")

fn map_keys(c: &enc.Cbor, why: text) -> List[enc.Cbor] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CMap(keys: ks, vals: _vs) -> return copy(ks)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: why)

fn map_vals(c: &enc.Cbor, why: text) -> List[enc.Cbor] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CMap(keys: _ks, vals: vs) -> return copy(vs)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: why)

fn arr_of(c: &enc.Cbor, why: text) -> List[enc.Cbor] ! BadReceipt
    match c
        CArr(items: items) -> return copy(items)
        _ -> fail BadReceipt(why: why)

fn tag_num(c: &enc.Cbor) -> i64
    match c
        CTag(tag: tag, item: _item) -> return tag
        _ -> return -1

fn cbor_copy(c: &enc.Cbor) -> enc.Cbor = copy(c)

fn tag_item(c: &enc.Cbor) -> enc.Cbor
    match c
        CTag(tag: _tag, item: item) -> return cbor_copy(item)
        _ -> return enc.CInt(v: -1)

fn kid_text(b: &[i64]) -> text
    let al = " !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~".chars()
    var s = ""
    for x in b
        if x >= 32 and x < 127
            s = s + copy(al[(x - 32) as usize])
        else
            s = s + "?"
    return s

const FIELDS: text = "jcp_receipt grant_id issuer subject resource action payload_hash frame_kind trust verdict deny_reason cost_uj energy_provenance energy_coverage budget_remaining_uj budget_uj steward chain_ids"

# Decode a core strictly: canonical bytes (enc refuses non-canonical
# input), only known fields, the right types, and the profile named in
# the core itself: jcp/2 needs payload_hash, jcp/1 must not cy it.
pub fn decode_core(payload: &[i64]) -> Receipt ! BadReceipt
    let c = enc.cbor_decode(payload) catch enc.CInt(v: -1)
    var r = Receipt(profile: "", grant_id: "", issuer: "", subject: "", resource: "", action: "", payload_hash: "", frame_kind: "", trust: "", verdict: "", deny_reason: "", cost_uj: -1, provenance: "", partial: false, budget_remaining_uj: -1, budget_uj: -1, steward: "", chain_ids: [])
    var seen = ""
    let ks = try map_keys(&c, "core")
    let vs = try map_vals(&c, "core")
    let fields = FIELDS.split(" ")
    for k in 0..ks.len()
        let name = try text_of(&ks[k])
        if not fields.contains(name)
            fail BadReceipt(why: "unknown field")
        seen = seen + " " + copy(name)
        let v = copy(vs[k])
        if name == "cost_uj"
            r.cost_uj = try uint_of(&v)
            continue
        if name == "budget_uj"
            r.budget_uj = try uint_of(&v)
            continue
        if name == "budget_remaining_uj"
            r.budget_remaining_uj = try uint_of(&v)
            continue
        if name == "chain_ids"
            let items = try arr_of(&v, "type")
            for it in items
                r.chain_ids.push(try text_of(&it))
            if r.chain_ids.len() == 0
                fail BadReceipt(why: "chain_ids")
            continue
        let t = try text_of(&v)
        if name == "jcp_receipt"
            r.profile = copy(t)
        if name == "grant_id"
            r.grant_id = copy(t)
        if name == "issuer"
            r.issuer = copy(t)
        if name == "subject"
            r.subject = copy(t)
        if name == "resource"
            r.resource = copy(t)
        if name == "action"
            r.action = copy(t)
        if name == "payload_hash"
            r.payload_hash = copy(t)
        if name == "frame_kind"
            r.frame_kind = copy(t)
        if name == "trust"
            r.trust = copy(t)
        if name == "verdict"
            r.verdict = copy(t)
        if name == "deny_reason"
            r.deny_reason = copy(t)
        if name == "energy_provenance"
            r.provenance = copy(t)
        if name == "steward"
            r.steward = copy(t)
        if name == "energy_coverage"
            if t != "Partial"
                fail BadReceipt(why: "energy_coverage")
            r.partial = true
    if r.profile != "jcp/2" and r.profile != "jcp/1"
        fail BadReceipt(why: "profile")
    let has_payload = seen.split(" ").contains("payload_hash")
    if (r.profile == "jcp/2") != has_payload
        fail BadReceipt(why: "payload_hash")
    let need = ["grant_id", "issuer", "subject", "resource", "action", "frame_kind", "trust", "verdict", "cost_uj", "energy_provenance", "budget_remaining_uj", "budget_uj", "steward"]
    let got = seen.split(" ")
    for f in need
        if not got.contains(f)
            fail BadReceipt(why: "missing " + f)
    let bad = check_fields(&r, r.profile == "jcp/2")
    if bad != ""
        fail BadReceipt(why: bad)
    return r

# Open an envelope without checking its signature.
pub fn open_envelope(env: &[i64]) -> OpenedReceipt ! BadReceipt
    let c = enc.cbor_decode(env) catch enc.CInt(v: -1)
    if tag_num(&c) != 18
        fail BadReceipt(why: "envelope")
    let inner = tag_item(&c)
    let it = try arr_of(&inner, "envelope")
    if it.len() != 4
        fail BadReceipt(why: "envelope")
    let ph = try bytes_field(&it[0])
    let pc = enc.cbor_decode(&ph) catch enc.CInt(v: -1)
    let ks = try map_keys(&pc, "protected")
    let vs = try map_vals(&pc, "protected")
    if ks.len() != 2 or ks[0] != jn(1) or ks[1] != jn(4)
        fail BadReceipt(why: "protected")
    if vs[0] != jn(-8)
        fail BadReceipt(why: "alg")
    let kid = try bytes_field(&vs[1])
    let uk = try map_keys(&it[1], "unprotected")
    if uk.len() != 0
        fail BadReceipt(why: "unprotected")
    let payload = try bytes_field(&it[2])
    let sig = try bytes_field(&it[3])
    if sig.len() != 64
        fail BadReceipt(why: "signature")
    let r = try decode_core(&payload)
    let kt = kid_text(&kid)
    if utf8_of(&kt) != kid or kt != r.steward
        fail BadReceipt(why: "steward")
    return OpenedReceipt(receipt: r, prot: ph, payload: payload, kid: kt, sig: sig)

# seal_receipt: sign the Sig_structure with the steward's 32-byte seed (hex).
# The steward must be the did:key of that seed's public key.
pub fn seal_receipt(r: &Receipt, seed_hex: text) -> List[i64] ! BadReceipt
    let core = try receipt_core(r)
    let pk = crypto.ed_pubkey(copy(seed_hex))
    let pkb = did_key_pk(&r.steward) catch []
    if hex_of(&pkb) != pk
        fail BadReceipt(why: "steward")
    let prot = protected_header(&r.steward)
    let sig = crypto.ed_sign(seed_hex, sig_structure(&prot, &core))
    let sb = hex_bytes(&sig)
    return envelope(&core, &r.steward, &sb)

fn hex_bytes(h: &text) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i + 1 < h.len_bytes() bound 16777216

pub fn replay(rs: &[Receipt]) -> List[Spend]

pub fn conserves(rs: &[Receipt]) -> bool
    var seen: List[Receipt] = []

        seen.push(copy(r))

        if r.budget_remaining_uj != r.budget_uj - s

    subject: text
    allowed: i64

pub fn tally(rs: &[Receipt]) -> List[Tally]
    var out: List[Tally] = []
    for r in rs
        var at: i64 = -1

        if r.verdict == "allow"
            out[i].allowed += 1
            out[i].joules_uj += r.cost_uj
        else
            out[i].denied += 1
    return out

# may branch. A failed check is a refusal, never a key: a caller must not
# feed "" onward as a secret.

# rejection key are branch-free: the key is kbar ^ (mask & (K ^ kbar)) with
# mask all ones exactly when the ciphertexts are equal.
fn mlkem_decaps(dk: text, c: text) -> text
    let d = unhex(dk)

    let differ = ((acc | (0 - acc)) >> 63) & 1
    let eq = differ - 1

# Signal's PQXDH over X25519, SHA-256 and ML-KEM-768. The initiator holds
# identity key ika and ephemeral key eka; the responder publishes identity
# IKb, signed prekey SPKb and an ML-KEM-768 prekey PQPKb signed with its

# into one-operation steps so each input stays inside the fuel of HC-7a:

#   responder: dh = pqxdh_dh_resp(...); ss = mlkem_decaps(PQSKb, ct)
#   both:      SK = pqxdh_sk(dh, ss)

# ciphertext gives another SS by ML-KEM's implicit rejection, so the first
# message fails to open. m is 32 logged random bytes (HC-10).
fn pqxdh_dh_init(ika: text, eka: text, ikb_pub: text, spkb_pub: text) -> text
    let dh1 = x25519(ika, copy(spkb_pub))
    let dh2 = x25519(copy(eka), ikb_pub)
    let dh3 = x25519(eka, spkb_pub)
    return dh1 + dh2 + dh3

fn pqxdh_dh_resp(ikb: text, spkb: text, ika_pub: text, eka_pub: text) -> text
    let dh1 = x25519(copy(spkb), ika_pub)
    let dh2 = x25519(ikb, copy(eka_pub))
    let dh3 = x25519(spkb, eka_pub)
    return dh1 + dh2 + dh3

# (FIPS 203 7.3), and an empty secret must never reach the key derivation.
fn pqxdh_sk(dh: text, ss: text) -> text
    if ss.len_bytes() == 0 or dh.len_bytes() == 0
        return ""
    return tohex(hkdf([], cat(cat(ff32(), unhex(dh)), unhex(ss)), tobytes(PQXDH_INFO), 32))

fn kem_ct_eq(a: List[i64], b: List[i64]) -> bool
    if a.len() != b.len()
        return false
    var acc: i64 = 0
    for i in 0..a.len()
        acc = acc | (a[i] ^ b[i])
    return acc == 0

# equal. No branch, no early exit; the caller has checked the lengths.
fn kem_ct_diff(a: List[i64], b: List[i64]) -> i64

# mask all ones exactly when the ciphertexts are equal.
pub fn mlkem_decaps(dk: text, c: text) -> text
